latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Contract-first codegen: opt-out of unknown-field preservation (PreserveUnknownFields) by @mgravell in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1368
* Fix StreamProtoReader pool state corruption after interrupted fixed-length deserialization by @PauloHMattos in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1376

## Maintenance
* Drop the explicit Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub reference by @mgravell in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1355
* Bump Grpc.Net.Client from 2.83.0 to 2.84.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1363
* Bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1369
* Bump NodaTime from 3.3.3 to 3.3.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1366
* Bump ICSharpCode.Decompiler from 11.0.0.9375 to 11.1.0.9782 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1364
* Bump the microsoft group with 11 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1370
* AotGrpcSmoke: don't generate the documentation file (fixes main CI) by @mgravell in https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/pull/1377


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/protobuf-net/protobuf-net/compare/3.4.30...3.4.40
